thread:
nina_oncall: Quick thought — our postmortem items keep drifting. propose a short 'ownership momentum' pilot to keep things moving.

omar_sre: what's the pilot look like?

nina_oncall: 3-stage flow: 1) 72h triage + mitigation, 2) 14d remediation + verification, 3) 28d final sign-off. Miss stage 2 -> oncall lead gets scoreboard ownership.

felix_pm: add a tiny ticket body so owners don't improvise. maybe a single-lined verification checklist required before close.

zara_dev: +1. also add a 'stale-signal' tag so ops-bot can surface items older than stage windows.

ops-bot: automated: will post 'ownership momentum' digest to #eng-oncall every Mon 09:00 and flag stale-signal items.

omar_sre: IC rotation tweak: shadow week then lead week; facilitator of the weekly 15-min remediation sync rotates with IC.

nina_oncall: comms cadence: owners paste a 1-line update in the incident thread every 72h until stage 3 closed. keeps stakeholders aligned.

zara_dev: can we script creation? `/remediate quick --owner=@zara_dev --due=72h --title="s3 cleanup"` to prefill ticket

felix_pm: pilot success metric: 50% reduction in stage-2 overdue after 4 weeks. if not, tighten cadence.

nina_oncall: i'll draft a one-paragraph README update and a tiny ticket template. omar can own recurrence detection. zara will prototype the slash command.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: pilot kickoff note will post Mon 09:00. digest enabled.

felix_pm: :thumbsup: thanks all — lightweight and measurable. let's start small.
